description.auto_refresh_interval_seconds: How often to automatically refresh volume data for all matched tickers
description.hover_refresh_delay_seconds: How long to hover over a ticker before triggering a fresh data fetch
description.feed_poll_interval_seconds: How often to poll finviz for new feed items
description.auto_refresh_check_interval_seconds: How often to check if auto-refresh should run
description.rate_limit_delay_seconds: Delay between API requests to finviz to avoid rate limiting
description.finviz_elite.enabled: Set to true to use Elite API, false to use free version
description.finviz_elite.auth_token: Your Finviz Elite API authentication token
